company.name: Aqarmap
company.shortDescription: Aqarmap is a real estate marketplace that specializes in providing real-estate management services.
company.description:
Aqarmap is a real estate marketplace that specializes in providing real estate management services. It features an online-based platform that allows users to buy, sell, and search for their ideal apartments and houses.

The company was founded in 2011 and headquartered in Al Qahirah, Egypt.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,000,000, or 95.24% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $620,944 to $7,149,686, a 11.51x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
